about: Hand-curated live-verify record (D-24026): did each Core card ability fire and do the right thing in a real match on play.legendary-arena.com? Distinct from the ledger status (is it implemented?) and the runtime hollow overlay (did it bite in a sim sweep?). state: verified | partial | pending. Edit by hand after a live match; cite the match id or PR in evidence. Hero/villain keys are `<ledger extId>|<mechanic>`.
